title: Climate resilience fund
prompt: Set up a $500K climate resilience fund for nonprofits in Illinois, Indiana and Wisconsin. Two review rounds: staff screening, then a community panel. Open Jan 15 to Mar 1. Awards up to $25K.

title: Small business recovery (government)
prompt: Kestrel County small business recovery grants: $2M total, awards $5K–$15K, businesses under 50 employees with a valid EIN, staff review, open for 30 days starting Feb 1.

title: Employee scholarship (corporate)
prompt: Northwind scholarship for employees' children: 20 awards of $5,000, GPA 3.0 or higher, one essay, blind review by a volunteer employee committee, decisions by May 15.
